ai.overview: The Jacksonville Jaguars bring the lineal championship belt to a neutral site showdown with the Houston Texans. Jacksonville has defended the belt 2 times in this reign and enters on a three-game winning streak, while Houston has dropped five straight and sits winless at 0-4 this season. The belt passes to whoever wins, with no committees involved—just the outcome on the field.
key_matchups: Jacksonville's three-game win streak versus Houston's five-game losing skid—contrasting momentum at its starkest
Houston's 32-16 all-time edge in the series against Jacksonville's current possession of the belt
Jacksonville's 4-1 record facing a Houston team desperate to avoid 0-5
ai.betting_angles: The form contrast is dramatic: Jacksonville has won their last 3 games and sits at 4-1, while Houston has lost their last 5 and remains winless at 0-4 this season. The Elo model favors Jacksonville, aligning with the current form disparity. However, Houston holds a commanding 32-16 advantage in the all-time series and won the most recent meeting 36-29 in November 2025, suggesting they've had Jacksonville's number historically even if recent form points the other way.
ai.prediction_writeup: Jacksonville's three-game winning streak and 4-1 record stand in stark contrast to Houston's five-game slide and 0-4 start. While the Texans have dominated this matchup historically with a 32-16 all-time edge, current form heavily favors the Jaguars. Jacksonville has already defended the belt twice in this reign, including wins of 19-17 and 22-17 in their last two outings—narrow victories that suggest they know how to close games. Houston's winless season and ongoing losing streak make it difficult to back them against a Jaguars team riding momentum and Elo favoritism.
